info.description: Curated work-graph HTTP API for personal API keys (`sl_api_…`) or OAuth tokens (`sl_oat_…`), including app-actor / client_credentials. Documents the API/OAuth response mode only.

bearer.description: Personal API key (`sl_api_…`) or OAuth access token (`sl_oat_…`)

description.description: Markdown. Stored as a Lexical document; preview is derived.

priority.description: 1 urgent, 2 high, 3 normal, 4 low. Defaults to 3 when omitted.

urlId.description: 12-character url id. Omitted values are generated.

description.description: Markdown. Replaces the ticket body and its content document.

metric.description: Clock to set. `firstResponse` is the first reply, `nextResponse` is the following reply, and `resolution` is time to resolve.

durationSeconds.description: Target length in seconds. Send null to remove the resolution SLA. Maximum is one year.

ticketId.description: Only this ticket's subscriptions, for every subscriber.

_id.description: Conversation UUID, subject-urlId slug, or conversation number. Omit when `conversationNumber` is set.

conversationNumber.description: Conversation number, for example 42. Omit when `_id` is set.

durationSeconds.description: Send null to remove the selected metric's SLA.

replacementLabelId.description: Conversations that used the deleted label move to this one.

replacementStatusId.description: Conversations in the deleted status move to this one.

conversationId.description: Only this conversation's subscriptions, for every subscriber.

replacementLabelId.description: Rows that used the deleted label move to this one.

inverseId.description: Id for the inverse row; the server picks one when absent.

body.description: The update text. API keys send markdown; the app sends Lexical JSON.
